5064.objectivesText: Locate and retrieve the three Secret Notes in Darkcloud Pinnacle.
5064.title: Grimtotem Spying

5481.description: Master want weeds. Us gots big hands and not good at picking. You help us and we not hurt you. Us need gloom weed. Many weeds around here and near road.$b$bWhen you have gloom weed you take to Master Holland in Brill graveyard.
5481.objectivesText: Collect 3 Gloom Weed and deliver them to Junior Apothecary Holland in the Brill graveyard.
5481.title: Gordo's Task

5482.description: So you can see the predicament that I'm in, $n. That thing is out there collecting the wrong weeds! I'll make it worth your while to gather what I need. Bring back to me enough doom weed and I'll give you a suitable reward.$B$BIt is my understanding that they like to plague the flora near the mass gravesite, to the north of the Brill graveyard. Hurry and be mindful of the gnolls in the area.
5482.objectivesText: Collect 10 Doom Weed and deliver them back to Junior Apothecary Holland.
5482.title: Doom Weed

5541.description: Hegnar Rumbleshot sells guns off the road to Anvilmar.  Riflemen and mortar teams spend a lot of time practicing out near his shop, and he's always needing fresh ammunition.$B$BBut... the last crate of ammo I sent him got lost along the way.  My courier said he was camped near the Grizzled Den when wendigo chased him away... and the fool left Rumbleshot's ammo behind!$B$B$n, can you get that ammo and take it to Rumbleshot?  He's been waiting on it and I'm sure he's running low.
5541.objectivesText: Bring Rumbleshot's Ammo to Hegnar Rumbleshot in Dun Morogh.
5541.title: Ammo for Rumbleshot

5622.description: $n, you must travel to Dolanaar when your business here in Shadowglen is done. There, you will find Laurna Morninglight. She will instruct you further in the ways of Elune, and it is with her that you will earn your first garments denoting your station as a $gpriest:priestess; of Elune.$B$BTake care, and may you be protected in your journeys.
5622.objectivesText: Speak to Laurna Morninglight in Teldrassil.
5622.title: In Favor of Elune

5625.description: It's usually about this time that one of your power is tested to see if they're worthy of wearing robes denoting their place in the church. But to be honest, I got more pressing matters to look into. Citizen of Kharanos' just came in here and told me 'bout a hurt mountaineer just outside town to the south--name's Dolf.$B$BYou heal Dolf and give him Fortitude, and I'll consider you done with proving yourself. How's that sound?
5625.objectivesText: Find Mountaineer Dolf and heal his wounds using Lesser Heal (Rank 2). Afterwards, grant him Power Word: Fortitude and then return to Maxan Anvol in Kharanos.
5625.title: Garments of the Light

5626.description: Hey! $n! Got a minute?!$B$BYa been following the Light now for long enough that you find your way to Maxan Anvol in Kharanos. He'll teach ya more about the path yer following, and if you prove worthy, give ya yer first set of robes to denote your station as a $gpriest:priestess;.$B$BNow get goin'! As soon as yer done here, head through the tunnel--he'll be waitin' for ya.
5626.objectivesText: Speak to Maxan Anvol in Dun Morogh.
5626.title: In Favor of the Light

5628.description: Ah, yes, hello, $n? I'm glad you stopped to talk for a moment. You are a far way from home at such a young age--I admire such ambition. I wish when I was younger I could have mustered the courage to travel the world.$B$BThere was a priestess of your order here looking for you not too long ago. She said it was very urgent you returned to the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus and speak to Priestess Alathea--it had something to do with your training. I wouldn't dally too long if you can help it.
5628.objectivesText: Speak to Priestess Alathea in Darnassus.
5628.title: Returning Home

5630.description: Hello there, $gladdy:lassy;. Good to see you travelin' far and wide to distant lands. No offense meant, but a lot o' your kind don't take well to these cold climates usually. Glad to see you're made of tougher stuff.$B$BNot too long ago one of your priestesses was in here lookin' for you--said somethin' about you finding a Priestess Alathea in the Temple of the Moon back in Darnassus. Said it was important and you should head back there soon.
5630.objectivesText: Speak to Priestess Alathea in Darnassus.
5630.title: Returning Home

5637.description: Time's come for you to head to Stormwind, $n. High Priest Rohan in the Hall of Mysteries wants to speak to you. Gotta be somethin' really good or really bad for the High Priest to want you there personally, but I'm guessin' you've only done well for yourself and it's a good thing that he wants to speak to ya.$B$BBut don't waste too much time 'round here. I'd head there as soon as you can.
5637.objectivesText: Speak to High Priest Rohan in Ironforge.
5637.title: Desperate Prayer

5663.description: Aelthalyste sent word out to all her priests. We're to direct the younger of our order to the Undercity for more training. If you truly count yourself among our faithful, then you should return there also.$B$BYou can find Aelthalyste in the War Quarter deep in the Undercity.
5663.objectivesText: Speak to Aelthalyste in the Undercity.
5663.title: Touch of Weakness

5677.description: As much as I'd like to show you our own special teachings of the Light, it is not our place. Your place is back in Stormwind with your own kind, $n... for now. Believe me, I mean no offense. When you return to High Priestess Laurena in the Cathedral of Light you'll understand what I'm talking about--the time has come for your race to prepare you for the future; to separate yourself from others that follow a similar path.
5677.objectivesText: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.
5677.title: Arcane Feedback

5678.description: It is time for you to return to Stormwind, young one. Your superiors there have called you back for more training. And although it disturbs me some, your race and mine are allies and I would not betray that.$B$BI do not mean to be so coy with you--my distrust of arcane magics, be they divine inspired or not, is still strong within me.$B$BYou will know of what I speak after you return to your Cathedral of Light. Speak to High Priestess Laurena when you arrive.
5678.objectivesText: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.
5678.title: Arcane Feedback

5725.description: Many denizens of the Legion bestow gifts on their followers as you may well know. Some of these gifts the Dark Lady feels would be better off in her hands than in the hands of those with... lesser vision.$B$BA sect of the Shadow Council hidden in caverns below Orgrimmar known as the Searing Blade are a prime example. The Lady tells me that members of the Searing Blade have come into the possession of two powerful spell books--she would like to "borrow" these books from them. You will get them for her.
5725.objectivesText: Bring the books Spells of Shadow and Incantations from the Nether to Varimathras in Undercity.
5725.title: The Power to Destroy...

5728.description: Hmm, leaders of the Searing Blade... this concerns me most. If they are the ones of value to Neeru, then those are who we must target first. This satyr... Bazzalan, and the other Neeru mentioned--what was he, a warlock?--must be slain.$B$BReturn to the Cleft of Shadow and enter Ragefire Chasm, $n. Find these two leaders of the Searing Blade, and kill them. But be careful not to let Neeru know it was you who did this. You must retain your identity as one of his $gbrothers:sisters; in arms.
5728.objectivesText: Kill Bazzalan and Jergosh the Invoker before returning to Thrall in Orgrimmar.
5728.title: Hidden Enemies

5762.description: I have a package for an old customer of mine, a dwarf named Hemet Nesingwary.  The package took weeks to arrive, and Hemet's long gone by now.  He said he was going to Stranglethorn to hunt the beasts there, but he left me some money to send his delivery when I could.  $B$BHemet's a rich dwarf and it's a good idea to keep up relations with the rich ones, yeah?  So... you want to deliver the package for me?$B$BI heard Hemet has a camp in Stranglethorn, north of Grom'gol.
5762.objectivesText: Take Kravel's Crate to Hemet Nesingwary in Stranglethorn.
5762.title: Hemet Nesingwary

5805.description: Welcome to the World of Warcraft!$B$BAs special thanks for purchasing the World of Warcraft Collector's Edition, turn in this gift voucher to Merissa Stilwell in Northshire Valley.  You'll then be given a gift: a little companion to join you on your quest for adventure and glory.$B$BThanks again, and enjoy your stay in the World of Warcraft!
5805.objectivesText: Bring the Northshire Gift Voucher to Merissa Stilwell.
5805.title: Welcome!

5841.description: Welcome to the World of Warcraft!$B$BAs special thanks for purchasing the World of Warcraft Collector's Edition, turn in this gift voucher to Yori Crackhelm in Coldridge Valley.  You'll then be given a gift: a little companion to join you on your quest for adventure and glory.$B$BThanks again, and enjoy your stay in the World of Warcraft!
5841.objectivesText: Bring the Coldridge Valley Gift Voucher to Yori Crackhelm.
5841.title: Welcome!

5844.description: Welcome to the World of Warcraft!$B$BAs special thanks for purchasing the World of Warcraft Collector's Edition, turn in this gift voucher to Vorn Skyseer in Camp Narache.  You'll then be given a gift: a little companion to join you on your quest for adventure and glory.$B$BThanks again, and enjoy your stay in the World of Warcraft!
5844.objectivesText: Bring the Camp Narache Gift Voucher to Vorn Skyseer.
5844.title: Welcome!

5847.description: Welcome to the World of Warcraft!$B$BAs special thanks for purchasing the World of Warcraft Collector's Edition, turn in this gift voucher to Claire Willower in Deathknell.  You'll then be given a gift: a little companion to join you on your quest for adventure and glory.$B$BThanks again, and enjoy your stay in the World of Warcraft!
5847.objectivesText: Bring the Deathknell Gift Voucher to Claire Willower in Deathknell.
5847.title: Welcome!

6062.description: It is an admirable skill to command one's authority over nature. As a hunter, you must strive to learn to use the force and power inherent to any creature of your choosing.$B$BGaining control of an animal is not an easy feat; it is a task that you must undertake with much determination.$B$BFor your first assignment, take this taming rod and use it to tame a dire mottled boar. You can find them quite close to Razor Hill. Practice your skills in battle with the boar at your side, then return to me.
6062.objectivesText: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Dire Mottled Boar. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Thotar in Razor Hill.
6062.title: Taming the Beast

6063.description: As a hunter, it is important to remember the responsibility you hold in your hands. Nature is not a power that can be bent to obey our desires; it is one that is to be respected and acknowledged as something stronger than your very existence.$B$B$n, you must prove your understanding of this before you will gain the ability to tame an animal to be your companion.$B$BYour first task is to take this taming rod. With it, you will be able to tame a webwood lurker. Tame it, and practice your skills as a hunter.
6063.objectivesText: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Webwood Lurker. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Dazalar in Dolanaar.
6063.title: Taming the Beast

6068.description: Hello, young hunter. You look to me like you are skilled enough to handle a beast and train it as your companion.$B$BYou must see Thotar at Razor Hill. He can put you on the path to earning a pet of your own.
6068.objectivesText: Speak with Thotar at Razor Hill.
6068.title: The Hunter's Path

6071.description: Hello, young hunter. You look to me like you are skilled enough to handle a beast and train it as your companion.$B$BYou must see Dazalar in Dolanaar. He can put you on the path to earning a pet of your own.
6071.title: The Hunter's Path

6084.description: Those crag boars are quite burly; maybe you'd like something with a little more finesse? Alright then, I've got jus' the thing. South and east of here, you'll find large white cats called snow leopards. Just like an elegantly-carved rifle, behind their beautiful exterior lies a powerful fighter, capable of doing extreme damage. You'll find them to be much more agile an' swift than the boar you tamed.$B$BTake this taming rod and see how you like the snow leopard.
6084.objectivesText: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Snow Leopard. Practice your skills, then return to Grif Wildheart in Kharanos.
6084.title: Taming the Beast

6087.description: You have a fiery spirit, hunter, readily awaiting your next challenge.$B$BYour next task is to gain the companionship of a wolf known as the prairie stalker. This creature is swift and fearless; in taking this beast as your pet, you must also take on these qualities.$B$BDuring a battle, you will learn how you and your pet will become a team. In the end you must work as one, muscle to muscle.$B$BHere is the taming rod, $n. Tame a prairie stalker and practice your skills.
6087.objectivesText: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Prairie Stalker. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Yaw Sharpmane in Bloodhoof Village.
6087.title: Taming the Beast

6121.description: You're now ready to learn about poison and the power we as druids have over it, $n.  Cenarius has blessed us with the ability to purge even the most foul of poisons with but a mere incantation.  This gift is not to be taken lightly... and to ensure you learn this lesson, you'll work to address the effects of poisonings as a layman would.$B$BTravel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze; he awaits your arrival to begin your lesson.
6121.objectivesText: Travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven.
6121.title: Lessons Anew

6181.description: Although we don't get much aid from Stormwind directly, I do have a contact in the city who helps supply us with armor.  His name is Osric Strang.  His shop, Limited Immunity, is in the Old Town of Stormwind.$B$BOur supply of armor dwindles, and I must contact Osric for more.  Can you take him this note?$B$BThe fastest way to Stormwind is through Thor, our gryphon master.  He's just down the hill; bring him my note, and then take a gryphon to Stormwind.
6181.objectivesText: Bring Lewis' Note to Thor the gryphon master.
6181.title: A Swift Message

6282.description: Tauren take pride as the protectors of these lands. Undoubtedly you can guess why I am alarmed with the number of harpies that dwell here in Stonetalon.$B$BThe Bloodfuries are the source of the increasing number of harpies in Kalimdor; they encroach upon all likes of life preventing the innocent from leaving their boundaries.$B$BI need you to cull the harpies, $n!
6282.objectivesText: Maggran Earthbinder in Sun Rock Retreat wants you to slay 7 Bloodfury Harpies, 7 Bloodfury Ambushers, 7 Bloodfury Slayers and 7 Bloodfury Roguefeathers.
6282.title: Harpies Threaten

6343.description: I must send a response to Nessa.  She'll be very interested to know how different the fish here are from those along Teldrassil's coastline.  We can only guess the cause, but it is my suspicion that the world tree itself is affecting the wildlife around it!$B$BPlease, take this response to Nessa.  If you wish to take a hippogryph back to Rut'theran then speak with the hippogryph master Caylais Moonfeather.  If you wish to take the ferry, then one regularly departs from the dock to the northwest.
6343.objectivesText: Bring Laird's Response to Nessa Shadowsong.
6343.title: Return to Nessa

6364.description: In order to fly to a town, you must have already been there and spoken with the wind rider master of that town.  You have been to the Crossroads and spoken to their wind rider master Devrak, so for a small fee you can take a wind rider to him from here.$B$BSpeak with me again when you are ready.  Once at the Crossroads, you can then deliver the leather goods to Jahan Hawkwing.
6364.objectivesText: Buy a wind rider to the Crossroads from the wind rider master Tal, then bring Ahanu's Leather Goods to Jahan Hawkwing.
6364.title: Return to Jahan

6382.description: Your strength impresses me, $c.  Your willingness to embrace the hunt gives me confidence that you could move on to bigger game... and bigger challenges.$B$BThe forests of Ashenvale represent a vast untamed wild that the Horde seeks to impose its own will upon, both politically and spiritually.  If you seek to prove yourself in an unproven land, seek the guidance of Senani Thunderheart in Splintertree Post.  The outpost is due north of the path leading from the Barrens.
6382.objectivesText: Speak with Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post, Ashenvale.
6382.title: The Ashenvale Hunt

6386.description: My wind riders are trained to fly to many different places, as long as you have already been to that place and spoken with the wind rider master there.$B$BYou have been to the Crossroads and spoken to their wind rider master Devrak, so now you can fly directly to him from here.  Once you're at the Crossroads, you can deliver Gryshka's letter to Zargh.$B$BSpeak with me when you are ready to go.
6386.objectivesText: Buy a wind rider to the Crossroads from the wind rider master Doras, then bring Gryshka's Letter to Zargh at the Crossroads.
6386.title: Return to the Crossroads

6421.description: Something is amiss here in Stonetalon. Can you feel the tension in the air, $n?$B$BSoutheast of here lies a deep cave in Boulderslide Ravine. The kobolds there are frantically mining a rare crystal called Resonite. I need you to bring back some ore samples so that I can understand what's happening in that cave.  I also need you to investigate the depth of that cave.$B$BGo young $c, it's imperative I know what evil lurks under these mountains.
6421.objectivesText: Explore deep into the cave at Boulderslide Ravine and bring back 10 Resonite Crystals for Mor'rogal at Sun Rock Retreat to investigate.
6421.title: Boulderslide Ravine

6481.description: You have uncovered a dark threat to the land, $c. The Resonite cask you have found in that cave houses a slumbering Earthen by the name of Goggeroc.$B$BI have changed the mixture of the Resonite crystals that you gathered with my shamanistic powers. Take the enchanted Resonite crystal and smash open the Resonite cask, which houses the Earthen.$B$BWhen awakened, Goggeroc will be weakened... Slay him, $n!
6481.objectivesText: Open the Resonite cask with the Enchanted Resonite Crystal, and then slay Goggeroc. Return to Mor'rogal with the news and Enchanted Resonite Crystal.
6481.title: Earthen Arise

6521.description: Malcin claims he is outside Razorfen Downs. This ambassador must be slain--his mission a failure in the eyes of the Lich King.$B$BHis presence there does explain much of what we've discovered about the area--some of the quilboar have grown frightfully powerful while showing signs of the Plague in their own way. Truly that must be a sign of some sort of deal they've struck.$B$BFind Malcin and slay him, $n. Return to me after the deed is done.
6521.objectivesText: Bring Ambassador Malcin's Head to Varimathras in the Undercity.
6521.title: An Unholy Alliance

6626.description: The Forsaken do not pass on their... illness... from what I have seen. This diplomat seems to be granting undeath to would-be followers. I am beginning to think he is one of the Scourge.$B$BFor now, my concern is not with him though, it's with the growing ranks around him. They creep from the shadows daily, almost begging him for more power.$B$BI'm not powerful enough to fight them on my own, $n. What do you say? Are you up for some hunting?
6626.objectivesText: Kill 8 Razorfen Battleguard, 8 Razorfen Thornweavers, and 8 Death's Head Cultists and return to Myriam Moonsinger near the entrance to Razorfen Downs.
6626.title: A Host of Evil

6964.description: Gifts, treats, presents... bah, I say!$B$BThose goblins pollute the true meaning of this season - the Feast of Winter Veil.  This is a time of renewal; the land slumbers under a blanket of snow brought forth by Greatfather Winter, who is NOT the bumbling fool over there in the red suit!$B$BIf you're interested in learning what the Feast is all about for yourself, ask Sagorne Creststrider.  I'm sure he'll be surprised that someone cares about history rather than getting presents.
6964.objectivesText: Speak with Sagorne Creststrider in the Valley of Wisdom of Orgrimmar about the Feast of Winter Veil.
6964.title: The Reason for the Season

7021.description: Have a wondrous Winter Veil, friend!  Be sure to say hello to Greatfather Winter, who's currently in Orgrimmar!  If you've been nice this year, you'll receive wondrous treats on the day of the Feast of Winter Veil.  Be sure to tell him what you hope to get this year!$B$BAlso, be sure to stock up on treats to give those who've been nice this year.  We have a great selection to choose from.  Fresh from our farm to your plate - it's Smokywood Pastures wholesome goodness!
7021.objectivesText: Speak with Greatfather Winter; he is located near the Smokywood Pastures vendor area in Orgrimmar.
7021.title: Great-father Winter is Here!

7062.description: Gifts, treats, presents... bah, I say!$B$BThose goblins pollute the true meaning of this season - the Feast of Winter Veil.  This is a time of renewal; the land slumbers under a blanket of snow brought forth by Greatfather Winter, who is NOT the bumbling fool over there in the red suit!$B$BIf you're interested in learning what the Feast is all about for yourself, ask Historian Karnik at the Explorer's League.  I'm sure he'll be surprised that someone cares about history rather than getting presents.
7062.objectivesText: Speak with Historian Karnik at the Explorer's League in Ironforge about the Feast of Winter Veil.
7062.title: The Reason for the Season

7321.description: Who says that the undead don't know anything about cooking? Take my secret recipe for Turtle Bisque, for example. I've known folks that would come back from the dead just to enjoy a bowl! Heh, heh...$B$BSpeaking of which, I haven't been able to make any lately.  I used to head over to Lake Lordamere myself to hunt snapjaws, the nasty things, but I can't pull myself away from my work here.$B$BIf you bring me some Turtle Meat from the snapjaws and soothing spices, I'll show you how it's done!
7321.objectivesText: Bring 10 pieces of Turtle Meat and some Soothing Spices to Christoph Jeffcoat in Tarren Mill.
7321.title: Soothing Turtle Bisque

7810.description: There must be more to being a master of the arena than this!   Perhaps the Pirate who runs the event at Gurubashi will know!
7810.objectivesText: Speak with Short John Mithril in the Stranglethorn Arena.
7810.title: Arena Master

8150.description: During the Harvest Festival of Azeroth, we give thanks to heroes for the sacrifices - in some cases ultimate sacrifices - they have given on our behalf.  The Horde acknowledges many heroes, but none exemplify strength and sacrifice more than Grom Hellscream.$B$BHelp us honor Grom by taking this offering to his monument in the Demon Fall Canyon of Ashenvale.  Place it at the base, and then return to me.  I'll only be here through the end of the festival, so waste no time in giving Grom his tribute.
8150.objectivesText: Travel to Grom's Monument in the Demon Fall Canyon of Ashenvale and use Grom's Tribute at the base of the monument.  Return to Javnir Nashak outside Orgrimmar before the Harvest Festival is over.
8150.title: Honoring a Hero

8161.description: The League of Arathor is sparing no expense in their move to retake Arathi.  They, and all the races of the Alliance, now stream to this distant region, intent on expanding their hold from Refuge Pointe.  We must stop them, and the best means to stop them is to take their supplies.$B$BYou can help us, $n.  Enter Arathi Basin, known for its rich mines, fertile land and skilled craftsman.  Capture and control every base you can, win the battle, and return to me with the resources you gain.
8161.objectivesText: Win the battle for Arathi Basin, get an Arathi Resource Crate, and return it to Deathstalker Mortis at Hammerfall.
8161.title: Cut Arathor Supply Lines

8311.description: I want to go trick-or-treating, but I can't because I'm sick.  If you go for me, I'd trade you the candy you get for some I already have!  I think you'd like this candy - it makes you turn into things both funny and scary!$B$BEach of the innkeepers in the big cities have candy they give for Hallow's End - talk to them and do the tricks they ask for!  Also, a little gnome named Talvash in Ironforge is handing out candy as well.  When you have all the candy, bring them back to me here!
8311.objectivesText: Speak with the innkeepers of Stormwind, Ironforge, and Darnassus, as well as Talvash del Kissel in Ironforge.  Perform the tricks they ask of you in exchange for the treats they offer.$B$BReturn to Jesper at the Stormwind Orphanage with a Darnassus Marzipan, Gnomeregan Gumdrop, Stormwind Nougat, and Ironforge Mint.
8311.title: Hallow's End Treats for Jesper!

8373.areaDescription: Clean up a stink bomb that's been dropped on Southshore!
8373.description: The thing I hate the most about Hallow's End are the stink bombs the Forsaken use on Southshore.  Who knew that celebrating liberation would have to involve such a smelly mess?$B$BDuring Hallow's End, use this cleaner to remove any nasty stink bombs the Horde may drop here in the village.  It uses the power of pine to fight funky smells.$B$BDo your part to keep Southshore clean, and I'll give you some Hallow's End treats I'm sure you'll enjoy.  We have a deal?
8373.objectivesText: Use a Stink Bomb Cleaner to remove any Forsaken Stink Bomb that's been dropped on Southshore.  Return to Sergeant Hartman in Southshore when you're done.
8373.title: The Power of Pine

8517.description: The war at Ahn'Qiraj is going to be long and bloody. It is a very wise thing that the Alliance is doing by enlisting the aid of you, and those like you, to build up the materiel necessary before plunging headlong into conflict.$B$BI have been asked to head up the collection of linen bandages for the war, and I am hoping that you are going to assist me in amassing as many as we need. It is no light matter, but at least the linen bandages are the least difficult to create. Are you with us, $c?
8517.objectivesText: Bring 20 Linen Bandages to Sentinel Silversky at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
8517.title: The Alliance Needs Linen Bandages!

8528.description: It may not seem heroic to gather up cooked fish, but do not underestimate the value of preparation, young $c. Soldiers need to eat like anyone else, and we're here to do our part to make sure they have what they need once the war in Ahn'Qiraj commences.$B$BAccordingly, I am stockpiling spotted yellowtail, a versatile source of sustenance that stores well and can be used in many different dishes. It also doesn't have the odor of some other saltwater fish. Are you willing to aid me in this endeavor?
8528.objectivesText: Bring 20 Spotted Yellowtail to Huntress Swiftriver at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
8528.title: The Alliance Needs Spotted Yellowtail!

8542.description: Lok'tar, $r, I'm sure you already know that we're going to war at Ahn'Qiraj with the insects. But first the Warchief has decided that we're going to do something called 'prepare'. Though I'd rather be sharpening weapons and hammering armor into shape, I'm proud to have been chosen to be in charge of tin bar collection here. But I cannot do that without your help.$B$BSo I need you to go out and make tin bars and bring them back to me here. I think I'm going to need more than I can count.
8542.objectivesText: Bring 20 Tin Bars to Grunt Maug at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
8542.title: The Horde Needs Tin Bars!

8792.description: Hello, I'm glad that you've decided to hear me out. The Horde needs all of the help that it can get to prepare for the Ahn'Qiraj War, and that means that we need you! Even now as we speak, official collectors are gathering the necessary material needed for the upcoming war, but we won't be able to meet our goals without your assistance, $n!$B$BYou should go speak with the guy in charge, Warlord Gorchuk. What do you say, $c? Will you help out with the vital preparations?
8792.objectivesText: Speak with Warlord Gorchuk in Orgrimmar's Valley of Spirits.
8792.title: The Horde Needs Your Help!

8793.description: Hello, I'm glad that you've decided to hear me out. The Horde needs all of the help that it can get to prepare for the Ahn'Qiraj War, and that means that we need you! Even now as we speak, official collectors are gathering the necessary material needed for the upcoming war, but we won't be able to meet our goals without your assistance, $n!$B$BYou should go speak with the guy in charge, Warlord Gorchuk. What do you say, $c? Will you help out with the vital preparations?
8793.objectivesText: Speak with Warlord Gorchuk in Orgrimmar's Valley of Spirits.
8793.title: The Horde Needs Your Help!

8867.description: Every year the druids of Moonglade hold a celebration of our city's great triumph over an ancient evil.$B$BWe celebrate the wisdom of our elders, share in magnificent feasts and of course... shoot fireworks!$B$BFor a small donation you can purchase colorful rockets from our vendor.  Try using some of the launchers around here, $n.
8867.objectivesText: Launch 8 Lunar Fireworks and 2 Cluster Fireworks and return to a Lunar Festival Harbinger at any capital city.
8867.title: Lunar Fireworks

8897.description: I've got to keep watch here at the gate, but I'm always worrying about my sweetheart, Colara. I only get to see her for a few hours, if I'm lucky, and well, just look at me. I've got a minor officer's pay and I could be called to the front any day now.$b$bWould she just forget about me? There are a lot of men in the city. A lot of rich ones.$b$bAnyways, I've scribbled some things down... nothing much, but if you could take it to her for me, that'd be great.
8897.objectivesText: Deliver Lieutenant Heldric's Carefully Penned Note to Colara Dean outside the bank in Stormwind.
8897.title: Dearest Colara,

8901.description: Have you ever known love, young one? It was a thing foreign to me until lately, when I met a girl from the Undercity, Elenia. It is rare enough for one of my kind to look outside our own, let alone one of the Forsaken.$b$bBut now thoughts of her occupy my mind both days and nights.$b$bIf you can, could you take this letter to her? I want her to come here to Mulgore. I hope that she will say yes.
8901.objectivesText: Deliver the Carefully Written Letter to Elenia Haydon near the bank in the Undercity.
8901.title: Dearest Elenia,

8902.description: A lifetime ago, I was betrothed to marry Elenia, my childhood sweetheart. It's been years since I thought about her last, but of late, she frequently occupies my thoughts.$b$bPerhaps, even with everything that has passed, there can be some room in each other's lives for our love.$b$bI'm sure she has changed, also. Can you deliver this letter to her for me? I am too nervous to give it in person.
8902.objectivesText: Deliver the Lovingly Composed Letter to Elenia Haydon near the bank in the Undercity.
8902.title: Dearest Elenia,

9368.description: Midsummer is upon us once again!$b$bEach year, as tradition dictates, Flamekeepers are chosen to tend the bonfires within our capitals. While fires are burning throughout Azeroth, it is imperative that ours be the hottest and brightest, to properly pay homage to the season.$b$bIn fact, I have a task for you, if you don't mind. I've not yet heard if the fires in all capitals are properly burning. Travel there yourself and warm yourself by the fires--make sure they're hot!
9368.objectivesText: Touch the bonfires within Orgrimmar, Thunder Bluff, and the Undercity, then speak to a Festival Talespinner within the capital cities.
9368.title: The Festival of Fire

9388.description: There are many flames burning throughout the world today, $n. The trickiest fires to tend are those that burn green; they do not stay lit long without supervision. Make certain the emerald fires still burn on Kalimdor for our Flamekeeper, eh?$b$bYou will find them near Ratchet in the Barrens, close to the Master's Glaive in Darkshore, in the forest of Ashenvale by the bridge near Silverwing Outpost, and near the road to Windshear Crag along the main road in Stonetalon Mountains.
9388.objectivesText: Visit the bonfires within Ashenvale, the Barrens, Darkshore, and Stonetalon Mountains, then speak with the Festival Flamekeeper.
9388.title: Flickering Flames in Kalimdor

9389.description: The Midsummer Fire Festival traditionally lights up the land with a myriad of flames. Some argue that the green fires are the finest, as they are the hardest to maintain and have such a distinctive hue.$b$bMake sure they still burn in the Eastern Kingdoms for our Flamekeeper. They sit near Dun Modr in the Wetlands, close to Pyrewood Village within Silverpine Forest, on the cliffs overlooking the lighthouse in Westfall, and by the ruined tower in Hillsbrad Foothills.
9389.objectivesText: Visit the bonfires within Hillsbrad Foothills, Silverpine Forest, Westfall, and the Wetlands, then speak with the Festival Flamekeeper.
9389.title: Flickering Flames in the Eastern Kingdoms

9419.description: We recently found out that the Horde has been scavenging the Silithus desert for resources, but paid them little mind. We thought it could not be worth it to station large numbers in this sweltering desert.$b$bHowever, it was discovered the importance of the resources, and now we are scrambling to catch up.$b$bIf I have your assistance, you must go into the desert and recover the silithyst and return it here.
9419.objectivesText: Find and deliver Silithyst to the Silithyst Extractor, then speak with Marshal Bluewall at the Alliance encampment near Hive'Zora.
9419.title: Scouring the Desert

65602.description:
You will need a powerful reagent to tempt an incubus -- an object that represents great devotion and love.

With my scrying, I have located a small figurine that should be suitable for your ritual.

Thousands of years ago, the figurine belonged to a young couple. The original owners are no more, but their keepsake has survived to the present day.

Follow the road north into Ashenvale, then west and past Maestra's Post. You will see a house nestled amongst the trees. There you will find what you seek.
65602.objectivesText: Retrieve the Wooden Figurine and bring it to Gakin the Darkbinder in the Mage Quarter of Stormwind.
65602.title: What Is Love?

65610.description:
I met Krilge while making Mooncloth in Ashenvale. He was stationed there to protect civilians from danger, until he disappeared...

They've stopped looking for him and consider him a deserter, but I don't believe it.

We would often meet at Fallen Sky Lake before it became overrun by those aggressive bog beasts.

I'm not typically one to ask favors, but if you could go to Ashenvale and look for any sign of him, I'd appreciate it.
65610.objectivesText: Investigate Fallen Sky Lake in Ashenvale and report your findings to Gan'rul Bloodeye in Orgrimmar.
65610.title: Wish You Were Here

76240.description:
I have one last idea that may lead us to success. I still feel there is hidden talent in you, but let us try and coax it out with a less direct approach.

Go and procure a Raw Brilliant Smallfish, then bring it back here. Use these daggers to clean and fillet it. Do not think too hard - do what comes naturally.
76240.objectivesText: Buy or catch a Raw Brilliant Smallfish, then use the Knife Set to fillet it in front of Boarton Shadetotem in Thunder Bluff.
76240.title: Stalk With The Earthmother

78823.description: The drawing is composed of rough, broad, strokes and seems to depict a large bird of prey. Despite the simple composition, the artist clearly viewed this creature with fear and awe. An expert on big game could likely tell you more.
78823.objectivesText: Bring the Primitive Drawing to Hemet Nesingwary in Stranglethorn Vale.
78823.title: Terror of the Desert Skies

79007.description:
<The faint radiance of the embers darkening, you stumble across the remnants of a recent fire.

Amidst the scattered provisions, you discover a blistered note.>

"Not all that burns is lost. Find the twin land, find the place."
79007.objectivesText: Charred remains of the note serve as your only guide.
79007.title: ... and that note you found

79008.description:
<The faint radiance of the embers darkening, you stumble across the remnants of a recent fire.

Amidst the scattered provisions, you discover a blistered note.>

"Not all that burns is lost. Find the twin land, find the place."
79008.objectivesText: Charred remains of the note serve as your only guide.
79008.title: ... and that note you found

79093.title: Rumi of Gnomeregan: The Collected Works

79229.description:
The campsite before you is a grisly scene. Judging by the remains, the victims were two humans and a dwarf. Markings on the bones indicate a savage attack, but the looted supplies tell you this wasn't done by an animal. The wounds don't match centaur weaponry either.

Perhaps an experienced scavenger of these lands would know what to make of this.
79229.objectivesText: Find someone in Desolace who knows about the pillaged campsite.
79229.title: Highway Robbery

79365.description: Here mon, a Squall-breakers Potion be what you need. Drink this to protect yourself against the elements of the storm, but remember it only goin' to last for a short while.$B$BNow go, return to your friends in need. There's nothing more I can do for you.
79365.objectivesText: Return to Rau Cliffrunner in Thousand Needles at Freewind Post.
79365.title: With Wind Beneath Your Wings

79624.description:
The recipe appears to be for some sort of meat dish. It is written in a language you don't understand. Ogre is your best guess, given the source and subject matter.

Ogres aren't usually culinary types but, if you knew one with such an inclination, they could translate the recipe for you.
79624.objectivesText: Find an ogre who can read the Illegible Recipe.
79624.title: Anyone Can Cook

79949.title: A Web of Lies: Debunking Myths and Legends

81734.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Rotting Orchard. Retrieve an intelligence report from Dreamwarden Dorilar there and return to me.
81734.objectivesText: Gather intelligence from Dreamwarden Dorilar in the Duskwood Nightmare Incursion in the barn at the Rotting Orchard and return to Field Captain Palandar.
81734.title: Duskwood Mission V: Worgen Intelligence

81735.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Yorgen Farmstead . Retrieve an intelligence report from Dreamwarden Amalia there and return to me.
81735.objectivesText: Gather intelligence from Dreamwarden Amalia in the Duskwood Nightmare Incursion in the farmhouse at the Yorgen Farmstead and return to Field Captain Palandar.
81735.title: Duskwood Mission VI: Dragon Intelligence

81745.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Rotting Orchard. Find the sleeping Druid of the Claw Kroll Mountainshade there and escort him to safety. Then return to me.
81745.objectivesText: Rescue Kroll Mountainshade from the Duskwood Nightmare Incursion in the guest house at the Rotting Orchard and return to Field Captain Palandar.
81745.title: Duskwood Mission XVI: Rescue Kroll Mountainshade

86776.description:
Thelsamar's a great place to live, but we don't have all of the amenities of Ironforge. I'm always running out of bronze! I need more bronze if I'm going to keep making tools and kettles and pots!

I can tell you have a little experience at the forge. Think you could smelt me some bronze bars? I can pay you well for it!
86776.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Bronze Bars to Morhan Coppertongue.
86776.title: Ingredients for the Forge

87318.description:
Thandol Span has been a dangerous place since the Dark Irons blew up the bridge, but I didn't expect to run into them there!

I managed to escape, but I lost sight of my partner, Essene. I've been searching all over for her, but I haven't found any sign of her. Did the Dark Irons capture her? Did she fall into the river below? Did she make it back to the other side? I don't know! I don't even know if she's alive!

Please, if you see any sign of her, let me know!
87318.title: Hearts of the Lost

87760.description:
I have received word back from Darnassus, $n!

From the animal samples, we learned that the naga dominated these sea creatures to use as unwilling mounts and beasts of burden. The ones that were too obstinate, or too old or badly injured, they drove out for sport. Monstrous!

It is our sacred duty to put a stop to this!

The naga have forces in the Ruins of Mathystra, and they must be seizing threshers from off the shore. Find their beastmistress, slay her, and bring back her tools of domination!
87760.objectivesText: Find a Stormscale Beastmistress, slay her, and bring back her Rod of Deep Dominion.
87760.title: Holy Diver

88756.description:
The Dark Irons have a few camps east of here on Direforge Hill, and they've stolen a bunch of explosives from our construction site and hauled 'em back to their tents.

I don't need tae tell ya what kinda mischief Dark Irons can get up tae with a barrel o' powder!

I know the Dark Irons are dangerous, but we need those barrels back. You can tell 'em from other barrels because of the red markings on 'em. We cannae let the Dark Irons keep 'em!
88756.objectivesText: Retrieve $1oa Stolen Explosives from the Dark Iron Dwarf camps.
88756.title: Bring Back a Bang

91282.description:
It is encouraging to see my newly risen brothers and sisters thrive as you have. It is only through community and shared faith that we can truly realize our full potential however, and to that end we've begun to form a new paladin order right here in Tirisfal. 

If you wish to learn more, you should visit our monastery on the edge of the Whispering Woods. It is called Bandarion Keep. It's on the bluffs just northwest of the Solliden Farmstead, and should be hard to miss.
91282.objectivesText: Find the fortress of Bandarion Keep and report to Breton Samuels there.
91282.title: A Second Home

91317.description:
Not all risen paladins have acclimated well to our new existence, as you may have seen yourself already. Some have carried forward their prejudices from life, and continue to visit violence upon their fellow Forsaken.

As it stands we are mistrusted by our people who remember well the persecution inflicted by the living in the name of the light, and these attacks do not help. A number of these tarnished have taken up residence at Shadowvale to the southwest. End them and bring me their leader's head.
91317.objectivesText: Slay 8 Tarnished Drudges, 6 Tarnished Zealots, and collect the head of Commander Rudolph Gelhardt in Tirisfal Glades.
91317.title: The Tarnished

91724.description:
Almost there, and... By the Nether! Something is still disrupting my instruments.

This is most frustrating, $n. I have heard rumors that the local bandits have been practicing spells near Stone Cairn Lake. Maybe if you stop them, these disruptions will finally cease and I can get some work done?
91724.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Defias Rogue Wizards at Stone Cairn Lake, then return to Hamish Bergwort in the Tower of Azora.
91724.title: Delicate Instruments

91746.description: The trophy serves as an impressive reminder of your victory over Elmpaw. A local hunter or skinner might be interested to hear the story.
91746.objectivesText: Deliver Elmpaw's Head to Helene Peltskinner near Goldshire.
91746.title: Elmpaw's Head

91777.description:
There are just two books left missing on Brother Paxton's list: "Geomancy for Curious Young Wizards" and "Arcane Explainer: Magical Stuff in Simple Words".

The kobolds must have taken them to the Jasperlode Mine. Please track down those two books and bring them back to Brother Paxton.

But I'm afraid it will be quite dangerous. If the "apprentice" kobold was summoning an elemental, who knows what the master can do. I'd bring some friends if I were you.
91777.objectivesText: Recover "Geomancy for Curious Young Wizards" and "Arcane Explainer: Magical Stuff in Simple Words" and return them to Brother Paxton inside Northshire's Abbey.
91777.title: Rare Books

91920.description:
I wouldn't dare to question the effectiveness of Apothecary Renferrel's formulae, however I would be lying if I said that the potion made any noticeable difference.

Along the shore of Lake Lordamere are a swarm of murlocs, and of note, murlocs have eyes. I suspect the apothecary's willingness to try new things is suppressed by his recent obsession with hearts. Bring him a few.

If my choice is to inevitably die a second death or have Renferrel kill me for questioning his methods, I choose the latter.
91920.objectivesText: Gather 3 murloc eyes and bring them to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.
91920.title: Wild Eyes

92421.description:
As a paladin of the Forsaken, it is my duty to exact the will of our Dark Lady while tending to our people's needs. We are fortunate with an opportunity to accomplish both.

Above the Undercity, the scourge still roam unchecked in great numbers. Our forces dwindle trying to reclaim our land, and decaying flesh cannot be reknit. Not without replacements.

Would that our glorious captain Garek Bandarion still be with us, I know what he would wish. To finish what he started and heal our kin. For Lordaeron!
92421.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Intact Limbs within The Ruins of Lordaeron for Morbin Lightbane in the Undercity.
92421.title: Light's Justice

92457.description:
The breach has affected many of our factotums and enchantments throughout the city, including many that are seeing to our defenses. This fragmented arcane energy has spoken to rogue elementals who seek to saturate themselves in this free flowing magic.

While we are busy tending to the wards and other major incidents, it would be a favor to the Kirin Tor if you could cull this elemental throng.
92457.objectivesText: Defeat $1oa Seeking Remnants, $2oa Saturated Remnants, and $3oa Mana Echoes inside the City of Dalaran for Archmage Modera outside of Dalaran.
92457.title: Starving Arcane

92460.description:
Look at you, bright eyed and ready for adventure! We need all the help we can get here in Thendal Village and your arrival is most welcome. I imagine you are brimming with nerves for what is to come. After all, you only get to come of age once in a lifetime.

Go, seek out our village leader Rorian the Dayseeker at the entrance to the greatfather tree just west of here. He will get you started on your journey.
92460.objectivesText: Speak with Rorian the Dayseeker in Thendal Grove.
92460.title: Coming of Age

92461.description:
We live in times of great uncertainty for our people. We face unprecedented challenges that may require bold solutions, but we also must contend with the ordinary and mundane here in Thendal Grove. Take, for example, the recent unsustainable rise in the vuldren population.

The vuldren are a vital part of our ecosystem. However, imbalances must be corrected to maintain the delicate harmony that all creatures in Thendal Grove share.

Head east and cull some of the vuldren there.
92461.objectivesText: Slay 8 Vuldren Juveniles in Thendal Grove.
92461.title: Harmony in Balance

92462.description:
One of our rangers recently reported an infestation of cirrusflies here in Thendal Grove. 

Cirrusflies can be dangerous if the swarm is allowed to grow too large, so please head to the eastern end of the Grove and exterminate as many as you can.
92462.objectivesText: Slay 8 Pesky Cirrusflies in Thendal Grove.
92462.title: Infestation Investigation

92467.description: A sapta is a drink created to bind our spirits to the elements. Fused with magic, the potion will allow the strong willed to see the elements as no one else can. Your spirit will be connected to the element the sapta was created for, and only a select few shaman know the recipe.$B$BThe sapta is always drunk in a sacred place, and never anywhere else--remember that.$B$BSeek out the Rise of Spirits up the pass east of here. Drink your sapta there, and... well, you will see what you need to see.
92467.objectivesText: Find the Rise of Spirits and drink the Earth Sapta.
92467.title: Call of Earth

92470.description:
Rorian informed you that I've been watching you. I now offer you a test of resolve. However, be warned--it will send you into great danger.

Go to the caves to the west. Thin out the ursera's numbers there, and find their matriarch, one the rangers call "Urs'anah". Put her down and bring me proof of her demise. Once you have done that, you will have taken an important step on your path.
92470.objectivesText: Slay 8 Ursera Scavengers and collect the head of the den mother, Urs'anah in Thendal Grove.
92470.title: Foul Matriarch

92472.description:
One of the most pervasive threats on Zephras Isle is the Al'Aketh Cult. They are religious zealots devoted to the worship of the supposed elemental ruler of Skywall, Al'Akir the Windlord. They are brutal, single-minded, and their power and ambitions are growing more deadly by the day.

Your path will soon take you to Shen'dar Village to the south. Present yourself to Constable Aonda when you arrive. The cult threatens Shen'dar and they are in need of aid. Tell Aonda that I sent you.
92472.objectivesText: Report to Constable Aonda in Shen'dar Village.
92472.title: The Next Step

92481.description: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident mage trainer--Dorii Brightwhisper--left this recall crystal for you. It contains some sort of message for you, so give it a look. Afterwards, you can find Dorii in the structure just behind me.
92481.objectivesText: Examine the Glowing Recall Crystal, then speak with Dorii Brightwhisper in Thendal Grove.
92481.title: A Student of the Arcane

92484.description: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident Shaman trainer--Windshaper Boro--left this recall crystal for you. Please examine it, then speak with Boro just over yonder near the center of the village.
92484.objectivesText: Examine the Humming Recall Crystal then speak with Windshaper Boro in Thendal Grove.
92484.title: Embracing the Elements

92485.description:
While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident druid trainer--Xyton Silverwind--left this note for you. Read it as soon as you can, and then seek out Silverwind on the ground floor of this great tree just behind me.

Heed his words and his counsel, he can teach you much.
92485.objectivesText: Read the Folded Parchment then speak with Xyton Silverwind in Thendal Grove.
92485.title: A Student of Nature

92519.description:
Apothecary Jorell was supposed to bring us a case of antidotes and elixirs days ago, but we're still empty handed. That fool has probably poisoned himself again by brewing in that poorly-ventilated shack he calls his lab.

If you want to further help our ward, you would be a far more reliable individual for this job.

Follow the road to Go'shek farm, south and a bit west of here. You'll likely find it packed and ready to go, with Jorell either missing or unconcerned with his obligations.
92519.objectivesText: Pick up a case of Packaged Tonics at Jorell's lab in Go'shek Farm and return to Doctor Gregory Victor in Hammerfall.
92519.title: Ward Restocking

92551.description:
I overheard you might be going to Falaath Village? While you are there, please keep an eye out for our stolen supply caches.

The Al'Aketh have been raiding our supply caravans carrying various goods such as food and windstones to and from the lowlands for months. They've been blaming the bandits, of course, but we all know that it all ends up in the same place. If there's any of that stuff left in Falaath, it would be a huge help if you could recover it.
92551.objectivesText: Collect 10 packs of Stolen Shen'dar Supplies from Falaath Village in the Shen'dar Highlands.
92551.title: Stolen Supplies

92644.description: <You reach beneath the still-warm body of the turncoat cultist and recover a small, glowing blue crystal. It appears to be damaged, but it may still be important. High Elder Shadowsong may be interested in this.>
92644.objectivesText: Deliver the glowing crystal to Talanaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
92644.title: Unfortunate News

92645.description:
This attack is going to be hard to repel unless we can take out the cult commander. Belguilos "the Breaker" they call her, and she's a veritable terror. She used to be a peacekeeper before the cult got out of control, and even then she was... off. As a cultist I can only imagine how much worse she could be now.

I might just be sending you to your death, but someone needs to take Belguilos out if we are going to survive here. You can find her at the villa at the hill's base. Good luck, $c.
92645.objectivesText: Slay Commander Belguilos in the Gustberry Lowlands.
92645.title: Breaking the Breaker

92646.description:
Lorthuna fled up to the spires above using some sort of portal. Ayessa and Elaadrin went in after her. That was just a few moments ago.

I'm afraid I took one too many hits and this is where I stay. Go through the portal, find Ayessa and help them stop Lorthuna.

Unless that help that Elaadrin and Ayessa said they sent for arrives soon, you are on your own from here. Good luck, $c.
92646.objectivesText: Take the portal to the Rohashi Spires overhead and join Elaadrin Evengale and Ayessa Dawnsinger in their confrontation with the High Priestess Lorthuna.
92646.title: Confront Lorthuna

92693.description:
You've done a lot to give us a fighting chance. Even if we die today, we'll at least know we gave it our best shot.

This is your last chance, stranger. If you want to head back to Valanaar and live another day, I wouldn't blame you.

On the other hand, if you really have a thing for lost causes just let me know when you are ready to go. We'll walk out there with our heads held high and whatever happens, happens.

objectives.text: Follow Aamelia and make your final stand

92693.objectivesText: Speak with Aamelia Windfield when you are ready to confront the bandit leader.
92693.title: Standing Our Ground

92699.description:
Now that you've arrived in Valanaar, you'll likely want to check in with the other members of the High Order here. The current Supreme Magister, Elaadrin Evengale and his people operate out of the lodge on the far southeastern part of Valanaar.

You should also take care, the High Order and Windshapers don't get along very well here. Be careful and give the Windshapers a good, wide berth. We've got enough to worry about with the cult, I won't tolerate faction violence in the streets of Valanaar.
92699.title: The Supreme Magister

92706.description:
Calling all anglers!

A giant shark has been circling the waters near the shipping dock, attacking sailors and small boats. Dockworkers have given it the nickname "Bruuz". A hefty reward will be given to whoever brings me its fin!

-- Gazlowe
92706.objectivesText: Bring Bruuz's Dorsal Fin to Gazlowe in Ratchet.
92706.title: WANTED: Bruuz

92709.description: Your highborne lineage shines as clearly in your eyes as the sky above. You are one of us, and it's youths like yourself that will help us save our home. But first, let me tell you more of our mission and plans here on Zephras... and beyond.
92709.objectivesText: Listen to what Elaadrin Evengale in Valanaar has to say.
92709.title: A Grand Adventure

92741.description:
The Shadowgale Forest is incredibly dangerous and is usually off limits to normal adventurers. In recent months there's been an explosion in the shriekling population and they've started to expand their territory outside the woods, which is a potential problem. I have an interest in the alchemical properties of shriekling talons, so a much-needed culling also presents an opportunity for scholarly gain.

Travel to Shadowgale Forest and hunt the beasts. Bring me as many of their talons as you can.
92741.objectivesText: Travel to Shadowgale Forest and collect 8 Shriekling Talons for Iaadaria Bitterwind in Valanaar.
92741.title: Unwelcome Visitors

92742.description:
We must determine the source and nature of the poison corrupting this land. Let us begin with the groundwater under the farms in the area.

Go to the Jansen Stead in the north and the Molsen Farm northwest of here, and collect samples from the wells there.
92742.objectivesText: Use the Well Water Sample Kit to collect samples from the wells at the Jansen Stead and the Molsen Farm.
92742.title: Testing the Wells

92743.description:
As the strongest centaur clan in all the land, we deserve armaments with ferocity that matches our strength! 

Warug needs one most of all. A helm... no, a crown! A conqueror's crown! I heard legends of a fearsome conqueror across the seas. Go to a place they call the Badlands and seek out a crypt there. Return to me only when you have found the crown.

Do this for me, and I will reveal the Magram's greatest strength.
92743.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and return a Conqueror's Crown from the Badlands to Warug in Magram Village.
92743.title: A Conqueror's Crown

92750.description:
I assume you want a "controlled" explosion? Not as much fun, but a good choice if you want to keep all your limbs.
I'm afraid I don't have a remote detonator--why don't you go check with the sneaky folks down at Stormwind Intelligence? They should be able to find us something.
92750.objectivesText: Talk to someone in Stormwind Intelligence about acquiring a remote detonator.
92750.title: Detonation at a Distance

92840.description:
Fillion was sent to the Overlook Standing Stones with a special device used to measure and study the elemental energy there.

Take this--an Index Esoteria--and use it to extract data from the massive windstone formations that form there. Be on your guard however, as the Windshapers are likely to be jealously guarding this site now.

Should any attempt to obstruct you, well... do what you need to do. I have no more patience for their interference.
92840.objectivesText: Take the Index Esoteria to the Overlook Standing Stones in Shen'dar Highlands and use it on the Windstone Formations in the area to gather data.
92840.title: Catching Wind

92841.description:
It is time, outsider, for you to learn of our great discovery... but Warug will not be the one to tell it!

Head south to the other end of the village. Look for a big, stinky centaur named Orgrul.

You will know when you get there.
You will know when you see him.
If he thinks you deserve to know, you will know.

And if he doesn't? Well. You can be happy knowing Warug has a new crown.
92841.objectivesText: Improve your reputation with the Magram, and locate Orgrul near the Valley of Bones south of Magram Village.
92841.title: Valley of Bones

92844.description:
Some sort of necromantic energy has permeated throughout the Valley of Bones, for reasons we have yet to understand.

Those reasons are also of no importance to us. The magic is ours now, and those who do not fight with blade or mallet are trained in this new magic.

If you think I intend to start you off with a challenging task, think again. For now, go into the Valley of Bones and fetch some bones for me. I am sure you can handle that.
92844.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring $1oa Gently Cursed Bones to Orgrul south of the Magram Village in Desolace.
92844.title: Mountain of Bones

92849.description: <Judging by what you've just found, it's very likely that Fillion befell some misfortune here. He may still be nearby, and he might be in need of aid. You notice a cave just to the north of your current location. You should continue searching for him there.>

objectives.text: Carry Fillion Flamebreeze to safety while avoiding enemies

92849.title: The Missing Scholar

92871.description:
Valennia Stormfist and her peacekeepers have ever been the protectors of Zephras, and we've done our best to lend aid where we can. There are rumors of larger-scale cult movements around the island, and they are clearly gearing up for something.

Report to Valennia and reiterate to her that the Windshapers offer their full support in Valanaar's efforts against the Al'Aketh, should the need arise.
92871.objectivesText: Report to Valennia Stormfist and let her know that the Windshapers are with them in their fight against the Al'Aketh.
92871.title: In Service of Zephras

92881.description:
The attacks on both the western and eastern watchtowers are not a coincidence. Based on what you told us about what occurred at the western watchtower with that skypriest, our best guess is that the cult is trying to do something to the anchor pylons.

Please speak with High Elder Shadowsong. He will tell you about a lead that could prove to be promising.
92881.objectivesText: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
92881.title: The High Elder's Request

92947.description:
Everyone is here, good. I've just sent a few of my best fighters in through the front of the shrine to cause a bit of trouble and serve as a distraction, while I lead the the bulk of our forces in from the flank.

If all goes well, we should be able to punch through quickly and take out the High Priestess. As for you, get in there and start cracking skulls. Meet my second, Hyusaa Quickbreeze, near the steps to the shrine after you've caused some trouble.

Winds guide you, $c.
92947.objectivesText: Slay $1oa Al'Aketh Guardians, $2oa Al'Aketh Spiritcallers, and $3oa Al'Aketh Blademasters, then report to Hyusaa Quickbreeze at the Shrine of Akir.
92947.title: Making Our Move

93037.description:
While I waited for your arrival, I peered a bit further between the arches and noticed something I need you to confirm for me.

I cannot bear saying it aloud. Not until my suspicions have been proven true.

$n, while you are getting your bearings in the valley, slay some of the necromancers that look weaker than the others. Tear off their ritual garb, carefully, and bring it to me. I must know whether I am of clear mind and vision.
93037.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis Clan, and bring $1oa Necromantic Garb to Nerlokh at the entrance of the Valley of Bones.
93037.title: Outing Outcasts

93065.description: The Peacekeepers are mobilizing and we are all gearing up to head out. Make whatever preparations you need to make and meet us at the eastern road leading north out of town. We'll have one final check-in with everyone before we move out.
93065.objectivesText: Speak with Valennia Stormfist in the Gustberry Lowlands.
93065.title: Prepare for Battle

93066.description:
On the other side of the valley, we have established a small foothold to prepare to march into the forest nearby. Before you head straight there, I want you to deal with a recent Bristleback intrusion along the way. They seem to have arrived right around the same time we did, but managed to secure an artifact from the nearby temple that has kept us at bay.

This task is simple. Look for the thorns and the pigs. Kill a bunch, indiscriminately. Then report to Hagiak at the camp I mentioned.
93066.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and slay quilboar at Bristleback Retreat. Then report to Hagiak at the Magram Front on the other side of Valley of Bones in Desolace.
93066.title: Bristleback Retreat

93128.description:
As much as I would like Uthek or Khan Shaka to give the order, I fear our window of opportunity is short. Too short to consult those at Gelkis Village.

I believe with the situation unfolding here at the Valley of Bones that the Magram have left Khan Jehn with minimal defenses. If there was ever a time to attack another clan's Khan, it is now.

But $n, a Khan is not to be trifled with, least of all Jehn. If you are brave enough to make your move, you must be swift but do not underestimate him.
93128.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and slay Khan Jhen at Magram Village. Once you have succeeded, report to Uthek the Wise in Gelkis Village in Desolace.
93128.title: Khan Jehn

93159.description:
Uh, um... h-hello, I mean to say, hi! Greetings, even! I'm sorry... it's um, been so long since I've actually spoken to another person. I'm afraid I'm a bit rusty at this.

<The strange hooded figure shifts uncomfortably before you.>

So er, um... how is your day going?

objectives.text: Learn more about the Strange Hermit

93159.objectivesText: Speak with the Strange Hermit in the Shadowgale Forest and learn more about him.
93159.title: The Strange Hermit

93226.description:
Siding with the Magram would be my choice. There is no question that they are the dominant clan in the present day, regardless of their previous struggles. I have heard reports that they are brutally hostile against the Gelkis.

I sympathize with both warring clans and especially the Gelkis, but this is their war; not ours. We ought to side with the faction that poses the least risk to our cause. I believe that to be the Magram.

Bring this to their quartermaster in Magram Village to the southeast.
93226.objectivesText: Bring the Totem Tote to the Magram Quartermaster at Magram Village in the Desolace to significantly increase your reputation with that clan. You must be of at least Neutral standing with the Magram Clan Centaur.
93226.title: Buying Friendship: Magram

93317.description:
Are you familiar with Windsong Crawlers? You see, these crabs are native only to Windsong Lake here on Zephras, and they are only able to be harvested a few weeks of the year.

With all of the cult activity of late, I've not been able to get out to the lake to harvest them, and our window is rapidly closing. I'd be appreciative if you could go and gather some for me. They can generally be found along the shorelines around the lake and in rivers.

Do be careful though, they are meaner than they look!
93317.objectivesText: Collect 6 pieces of Windsong Crawler Meat.
93317.title: Crab Season

93585.areaDescription: Escort Father Tuttle to The Harborage
93585.description:
Oh thank goodness, someone civilized!

I came here on behalf of the Church of the Holy Light to make contact with the draenei of the Harborage. The Alliance has no foothold here, you see, and a bit of diplomacy with the locals may help us in that regard. The Light welcomes all into its fold, after all!

However, the road past this bridge is crawling with the draenei's more savage kin. If I am to make it to the Harborage safely, I will need protection. Would you aid me, $c?
93585.objectivesText: Escort Father Tuttle to The Harborage.
93585.title: This Light of Mine

93663.description:
The draenei of the Harborage are skilled fishermen, and willing to trawl more dangerous waters than I. We occasionally trade. They give us some of their catch, and I offer some of our extra supplies.

I'd sent a goblin courier to deliver my latest shipment, but he never returned. A crocolisk likely made a meal of him.

More importantly, my business reputation is at stake. That shipment must be found, and delivered to the harborage. Please, find it if you can. Check near the waters along the road.
93663.objectivesText: Find the missing courier, and ensure Dar's shipment is delivered to the Harborage.
93663.title: Lost in Transit

93735.description:
Historically, the Windshapers have seen to the tending of the magical instruments and devices that were gifted to us by the spirits of the wind. This includes the myriad of magical constructs around the island. Since the spirits left us, only a scant few of these are still functional.

One of the few remaining working constructs in Valanaar has become damaged. One of our artisans was dispatched to help, but he may be in need of aid. Travel to the west end of the city and offer any assistance you can.
93735.objectivesText: Find Riaani Nightwind on the west side of Valanaar.
93735.title: The Broken Construct

93958.description:
Valennia's forces just breached the inner sanctum. The fighting was thick in there at first, but it's grown... unsettlingly quiet. Go in there and do your best to link up with Valennia and her forces... if any of them are left.

I'll stay here and watch your back.
93958.objectivesText: Speak with Valennia Stormfist inside the inner sanctum at the Shrine of Akir.
93958.title: The Inner Sanctum

94003.description:
I am all that remains of the line of Skybreakers here on Zephras Isle. The rest were murdered by the Al'Aketh.

The only thing that outweighs my sorrow is my shame. My family's ancestral shield--the Skybreaker Bulwark--is now in the hands of a cultist named Zaal Stormshield. Family lore holds no harm may befall a worthy wielder of this shield.

Zaal is not worthy, of that I am sure. Find this man at the Shrine of Akir and reclaim my shield from him. Do this and I will teach you the Skybreaker Defense.
94003.objectivesText: Reclaim the Skybreaker Bulwark from Zaal Stormshield at the Shrine of Akir.
94003.title: The Skybreaker Bulwark

94216.description: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Elixir of Lesser Agility, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94216.objectivesText: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
94216.title: Craftsman's Writ: Elixir of Lesser Agility
