94434.description:
Wait, you want to... help? Why would a paladin want to help a beggar like me?

Well, I suppose that you could be of some assistance. 

It's my wife you see. She, well... she's falling apart. I mean that literally. The apothecaries can stitch her back together right as rain, but they are about the Dark Lady's business and none are available to help. If you could perhaps bring me some fresh cloth then I could at least make her a wrapping to hold her together while we wait for the apothecaries.
94434.objectivesText: Bring 10 Linen Cloth to Tanis Alderwood in the Undercity.
94434.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94436.areaDescription: Speak with Deathguard Billmuth at Tyr's Watch.
94436.completionText: Speak with Deathguard Billmuth at Bandarion Keep.
94436.description:
It's time to demonstrate your ability to channel one of the light's greatest gifts.

The item I just gave you is called the Symbol of Life. Take care, as it may cause you some discomfort to handle a talisman of the light such as this. The light may be anathema to the force that created us, but it is still our guide and ally. The pain reminds us of this.

Go see Deathguard Billmuth downstairs. He just arrived and he has petitioned us for aid. Show him and the Forsaken what a true paladin can do.
94436.objectivesText:
Speak with Deathguard Billmuth at Bandarion Keep.

Should you misplace your Symbol of Life, return to Danitha Morr for a replacement.
94436.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94438.areaDescription: Take the Symbol of Life and use it to resurrect Deathguard Falgan at Venomweb Vale.
94438.completionText: Take the Symbol of Life and use it to resurrect Deathguard Falgan at Venomweb Vale.
94438.description:
Falgan and I were sent on a mission to scout out scarlet activity in Venomweb Vale. We managed to sneak close enough to one of their camps to hear about new orders involving an attack on Brill. Before we could decide what to do next, I stepped on a twig and the noise alerted them to us.

Falgan yelled at me to run, so I ran. By the time I realized he wasn't with me, I was halfway to Brill. That brave idiot probably stayed behind to hold them off for me.

Please, find my friend and help him if you can.
94438.objectivesText:
Take the Symbol of Life and use it to resurrect Deathguard Falgan at Venomweb Vale. 

Should you misplace your Symbol of Life, return to Danitha Morr for a replacement.
94438.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94440.description:
These Scarlet Crusaders often carry satchels with their deployment orders. We know an attack is coming, but if we can recover their orders, we can warn the rest of the Deathguard and prepare an ambush. 

You are clearly an impressive paladin. Kill these scarlet animals and retrieve a copy of their orders and bring them back to Deathguard Billmuth. He'll take it from there.
94440.objectivesText: Retrieve the Scarlet Crusade Attack Plans from the Scarlet Crusaders at Venomweb Vale, and return to Deathguard Billmuth at Bandarion Keep.
94440.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94468.description: Torch firmly in hand, you turn away from the brazier and look out over Loch Modan. You feel an excitement tugging at your spirit as the wind picks up and forces the flame to dance violently.$B$BYou start off down the path back to Dun Morogh in search of Bruegs Kindleborn.
94468.objectivesText: Bring the Torch of Eternal Flame to Bruegs Kindleborn in Dun Morogh.
94468.title: Call of Fire

94779.description: Praise be to Elune, and to your Light, $n.$B$BAbout this time, many of our order learn abilities reflecting their faith in Elune. If knowledge serves me, I believe the same holds true for your order also.$B$BWhen your business in Darnassus is complete, I would seek out one of your High Priestesses for further training.
94779.objectivesText: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.
94779.title: Divine Grace

94821.description: A priest recently visited our halls seeking you out, young $r. He said that he was on a mission to find you and that you should return to the Hall of Mysteries in Ironforge as soon as possible. When you arrive, seek out High Priestess Mims--she will tell you more.$B$BThe Light be with you, $n.
94821.objectivesText: Speak to High Priestess Mims in Ironforge.
94821.title: Confounding Flash

94872.description:
The fierce Magram are undoubtedly winning the war of territories at the moment. While we can all be thankful the clashes haven't erupted too frequently throughout the desert, every day their village just to the east grows a little bigger; their soldiers a little bolder.

I worry gravely about the consequences of an unchecked Magram clan, but I cannot deny their potential as an ally.

If you wish to earn their trust, offer this sack of totems to their quartermaster, but be careful.
94872.objectivesText: Bring the Totem Tote to the Magram Quartermaster at Magram Village in the Desolace to significantly increase your reputation with that clan. You must be of at least Neutral standing with the Magram Clan Centaur.
94872.title: Buying Friendship: Magram

94896.description:
You look like a capable adventurer. Do you happen to be headed towards Shadowgale Forest? Ban'aethal lies deep in the forest; that's where we're all from.

<Ealaane gestures to the other refugees.>

We've recently had to evacuate Ban'aethal, as it began to fall into the sky. It was sudden and in the middle of the night. If you are headed that way, would you please look for any belongings left behind? The forest and village are far too dangerous for us to return to now.
94896.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Abandoned Belongings from the ruins of Ban'aethal.
94896.title: Aid For The Refugees

94947.description:
It's a big world down here, and we need our people to start branching out to explore it. That's where you come in.

The Kirin Tor is a member of an "Alliance" of like-minded nations. The de-facto heart of this alliance is the city of Stormwind to the south. Elaadrin has asked me to find someone to travel to Stormwind and meet with the regent lord there, a human named Bolvar Fordragon.

When you are ready, the Kirin Tor mages have set up a special portal for the High Order to use to access Stormwind.

objectives.text: Take the Skyborne Portal to Stormwind

94947.objectivesText: Take the Skyborne Portal to Stormwind and report to Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind Keep.
94947.title: Welcome to Azeroth

95036.description:
Trevan tells me that the worgen are a major threat to the citizens of Silverpine Forest. Despite their strength and resilience they can be killed, but there is one in particular that just doesn't ever seem to stay dead due to unknown magic.

That's the one that attacked us. He is known as Old Fire-Eye and he is the biggest and meanest of their kind. To put him down, we'll need a special kind of weapon.

Speak with Trevan and he will supply you with a list of what is needed to forge such a weapon.
95036.objectivesText: Speak with Trevan Rol in the Sepulcher and bring him the materials he requires.
95036.title: A Moon-Kissed Blade

95065.description:
What a view... Best an old man can ask for.

The fish sure are bitin' now, though I'm down to my last bait. I don't suppose you have any spare fishing supplies on you? Of course not, forgive me. I get so excited at the thought of casting another line it didn't dawn on me I may be one of the few carrying supplies everywhere I go.

Would you be able to help refresh my stock? Catherine Leland has an assortment of fishing goods just west of the Trade District along the canals. Tell her old Gray sent you.
95065.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Shiny Bauble and $2oa Nightcrawlers to Gilbert Gray at the harbor in Stormwind.
95065.title: Fishin' Time

95161.description:
If you're looking for Jeremy Heartweaver, your best bet is to talk to his newly adopted mother, Avette Fellwood out in Duskwood. Sweet woman. Likely needs another pair of hands for her work, but it beats staying in the orphanage.

If you see little Jeremy, do be sure to tell him we're all thinking of him, won't you?
95161.objectivesText: Deliver the Blood-Stained Letter to Avette Fellwood in Duskwood.
95161.title: Remember That I Love You

95328.description: Against your better judgement you scrape up and collect the squirming remains of the beast. Someone in Undercity might have a use for them.
95328.objectivesText: Deliver Whispering Horror Residue to Father Lankester in the War Quarter of Undercity.
95328.title: Whispering Horror Residue

95664.description: This unusual composite shard scatters light like a living prism. Its nature is uncertain, but its power feels ancient. The most knowledgeable minds for artifacts of this bygone age must reside on the Elder rise in Thunder Bluff.
95664.objectivesText: Take the Titan Relic to the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff and look for someone who can tell you more about it.
95664.title: Elder Knowledge

95697.description:
Zamja tells me we need more homestyle cooking.
If we start selling raptor, she thinks it'll draw in customers who don't usually visit Borstan's Firepit.

Her idea is not so bad. But I want something that rises above the smells of our birth villages. We're in Orgrimmar! Borstan should serve a grand take on their familiar favorites.

A hunter recently came back from the Wetlands with a giant talon from the thicket raptors in the Excavation Sites.

Up for a job?
95697.objectivesText: Enter the Excavation Sites in the Wetlands and bring back Thicket Raptor Meat.
95697.title: Changing Tastes

95816.description:
Greetings, accomplished craftsperson!

Completion of this form will grant you non-exclusive, revocable, and legally limited permission to display advertisement signs for your tradeskill(s) all across Azeroth!

Once completed, please bring this to your local Azeroth Commerce Authority branch's Contract Coordinator to begin processing.

Happy crafting!
95816.objectivesText: Bring the completed form to Elaine Compton in Redridge Mountains.
95816.title: Sign Me Up!

96138.description:
A bow left by the spirit of Merrick Valor, famed Watcher who prided himself on keeping the roads safe from encroaching enemies.

With Merrick's spirit still wandering the roads, perhaps his unfinished business was to clear out invaders near his home in Raven Hill. The ogres south of town may be what's troubling his spirit.
96138.objectivesText: Defeat $1oa Splinter Fist Warriors and $2oa Splinter Fist Taskmasters then return to Sirra Von'Indi in Darkshire for more information.
96138.title: Merrick's Bow

96243.description:
It's past time ye heeded the earth, brave Shaman. The elements already prickle in yer skin, but once ye speak with the stone, the ground itself'll set firm 'neath yer soles--and in yer soul.

Seek out Teo Hammerstorm, in Coldridge Valley. Ye'll find him within Anvilmar, a holdfast forged by hammer, fire, and will.
96243.objectivesText: Find Teo Hammerstorm in Dun Morogh.
96243.title: Call of Earth

96339.title: Legacy Reward: Replica Ironforge Air Rifle

96394.description:
Something has disturbed the tombs down in the Hall of Thanes, and strange noises have been heard coming from deep within the vaults. The spirits of the dead are light sleepers, and whatever is going on down there seems to have startled them.

Head down there and see what you can do about that for us. If any of the dead are awake--well, put them back down!
96394.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Enraged Apparitions, $2oa Tormented Souls and put the spirit of Anvilmar to rest.
96394.title: The Restless Dead

96638.description:
More and more adventurers like yourself have been seeking glory and fortune outside of the safety of Thendal Grove. There's one such adventurer who has made a camp outside of Shen'dar Village, along the road leading southwest out of Thendal Grove.

Seek him out and see what you can learn from him that may help you in your own travels.
96638.objectivesText: Speak to Raan Wildwind near Shen'dar Village.
96638.title: The Adventurer

96652.description:
<The journal appears to be quite plain, detailing the life and adventures of someone you've never heard of.

There are multiple entries mentioning camping. It seems to be quite... fun.>
96652.objectivesText: Bring the journal to Brakk near Razor Hill.
96652.title: The Adventurer

96655.description:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.

objectives.text: Learn cooking from Cook Torka in Razor Hill

96655.objectivesText: Speak with Cook Torka in Razor Hill to learn to become a cook.
96655.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96774.description:
The ancient Gurubashi of Stranglethorn Vale were da masters of dark blood magics. Rumors be they'd use pure truesilver idols to channel that bad bad voodoo.

Ol' Mazu'kon would love to get his hands on one of those idols... for academics ya see. How 'bout you gather some friends and do a bit of smash and grab on that drowned city stickin' out the ocean off the coast of Stranglethorn? Kill the most impressive lookin' priest ya can find in there, and they sure to have what I be lookin' for.
96774.objectivesText: Recover an Ancient Gurubashi Idol from the Drowned City.
96774.title: Ancient Gurubashi Idol

96781.description:
We have noticed a Syndicate scouting party prowling around the ruins of Alterac, led by a man named Barton.

They're clearly searching for something, but I cannot know what without reading his scouting reports.

I ask that you pickpocket the report from him, rather than killing him outright. Barton's death will tip off the Syndicate that we're on to them, and they will certainly take counter-measures to cover their tracks.

If you hope to find him, he is most likely among the Syndicate at Strahnbrad.
96781.objectivesText: Steal Barton's Scouting Report by pickpocketing it from him. Then, bring the report to Myrokos Silentform at Ravenholdt Manor.
96781.title: What's the Big Idea?

96984.description:
You may not have our best interests at heart, but I won't deny an extra pair of hands. And if Dalaran falls, it takes everything with it--including your Undercity.

So, your benefactor wants in? Fine. I'll imbue your key to work past my wards so you can enter the city. Once you're in, meet me at the Violet Citadel where this all began. With everything going on the Kirin Tor will be too busy to stop you.

Scavenge what you will, but whatever happens, our first priority is to prevent a catastrophe.
96984.objectivesText: Collect the Arcane Mote in the City of Dalaran for Magus Wordeen Voidglare in Tarren Mill.
96984.title: Heart of Disruption

96986.description:
Within the underbelly of the mage city to the north is a traitor to our kind. A necromancer of disturbing talent. He raises an army of undeath right under the Kirin Tor's nose.

I care not for the fate of the mage city, $n, but this grave knight spits in the face of everything we Forsaken stand for. Put an end to him. Show him no one is beyond the reach of the Dark Lady.
96986.objectivesText: Defeat Atrexis the Grave Knight in the City of Dalaran for Melisara in Tarren Mill.
96986.title: The Grave Knight

96988.description:
With the city of Dalaran under siege by their own constructs, this is the perfect opportunity to, let's say, borrow a few samples.

Imagine an army of arcane-powered abominations. The Dark Lady would have no choice but to recognize my alchemical prowess. Maybe even grant me head of the Royal Apothecary Society?

Go to the city and find the constructs' cores. They are unlikely to give them willingly, so do what you must.
96988.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Cracked Sentry Cores in the City of Dalaran for Doctor Martin Felben in Undercity.
96988.title: Source of Power

97220.description:
Every day this week we've been short dockhands.

Care to ease the stress on our cargo schedule?

Take this package to the stockroom entrance of the Gatehouse. You'll find it inside Trias' Cheese shop on the second floor. The mistress, Elaine, will be quite familiar with the deliveries. The Gatehouse often has shipments arriving with more discretion to allow for ceremonial surprises on behalf of the guard's officers.
97220.objectivesText: Bring the Gatehouse Shipment to the stockroom entrance located in Trias' Cheese shop in the Trade District.
97220.title: Philmor's Favor

97242.description:
Yelmak doesn't want his apprentice breaking anything. Well, anything more than he already has.

He told me the young mixer in training has too much pride to ask for help when he really needs it. Yelmak wants to give him a taste of a particular home-brewed recipe.

Gather a mix of cattail and speargrass cuttings taken from the plants growing around the water in the Valley of Honor. I'd get them myself, but if I left the shop, Whuut would surely know we're catering to his mood.
97242.objectivesText: Take some cuttings from the Cattails and Speargrass growing around the water flows in the Valley of Honor and return to Kor'geld in Yelmak's Alchemy and Potions.
97242.title: Yelmak's Medley

97249.description:
Now that I know his parents worry about how much he's actually filling that belly, I've got an idea. 

They made me promise not to pack the same meal every day, so Migi grows a taste for more than one thing. Still, whenever the smoker's full and we're making sweetglazed hog belly sandwiches, he always shows up for lunch. We've started crumbling the leftover crispy glazed bits as a topping--something we can add daily. 

Take this to him. Maybe he'll start showing up early and bringing friends!
97249.objectivesText: Bring Migi's Lunch to him behind Grommash Hold.
97249.title: Favorite Food

97275.description:
Whuut is a prodigy. That much is true. But he doesn't yet have the experience, wisdom, and time on the stirring rod to know how to respect alchemical processes.

He is exhausting all of the rarest and most exotic reagents we have available without pausing to practice and refine his basic skills.

Give him this potion I've brewed with a quick tonic method. He'll reconsider everything he's doing when he learns how local remedies and careful touch are the first true mastery.
97275.title: Whuut's the Rush

97279.description:
With an influx of new recruits like yourself, it's been hard to keep our weapons supplied. Our weaponsmith, Kzan, is running low on training weapons and I'd like to see what kinds of skills you possess to get an idea of what I have to work with. Luckily for you, I have a solution to both.

While you're out there cutting your teeth on boars, salvage six abandoned training weapons. Our failed recruits left them laying on the ground. Once you do, return them to our weaponsmith Kzan behind me in the Den.
97279.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Abandoned Training Weapons, then return to Kzan Thornslash in the Den.
97279.title: Wayward Weapons

97291.description:
With the head reattached, all we need now is to bind it to the Dark Lady's will. This should not be a problem. The beast barely has brains left as it is after all the beatings it's taken.

We simply need to motivate it.

Fetch me a Toxic Skullcap from Miss Grisette in the Trade Quarter. Oh, and some Blisterweed from our local herbalist trainers, the Alliestars. Feel free to just take some, they owe me. And lastly a bit of Essence of Agony. Any old poison vendor should do.

We have a potion to make!
97291.objectivesText: Collect a Toxic Skullcap from Tawny Grisette in the Trade Quarter, Blisterweed near the Herbalism Trainer, and Essence of Agony from the poison vendor in the Rogues' Quarter for Master Apothecary Faranell in Undercity.
97291.title: Unending Torment

97292.description:
I have concocted a lovely serum that our new guest is sure to find quite... stimulating.

Take this. Feed it into the workings dripping from above him. Let's see if we can't show him why it's in his best interest to serve loyally.

And try not to drop it. I can't afford a new assistant.
97292.objectivesText: Inject the Hissing Serum into the system above Othmar's body for Master Apothecary Faranell.
97292.title: Unending Torment

97328.description:
<As you sift through the debris left behind by a horrible zeppelin crash directly above, you find evidence of a hefty shipment of supplies that has long since been plundered of all its value. Even the shipping labels have been torn and shredded, leaving only the words 'Booty Bay' barely legible on one.

Countless two-toed footprints and several patches of divotted earth all lead toward ruins in the northwest.>
97328.objectivesText: Recover $1oa Stolen Shipments from the Ruins of Zul'Kunda in Stranglethorn Vale and return your haul to someone in Booty Bay.
97328.title: Anything of Value

97331.description:
Wait, wait, don't go yet!

I know I said I just needed the key but... well, they caught me once, they could do it again, right? I'm just one goblin, and there's hundreds of trolls around here!

You've already put enough of a dent in their numbers to get this key, so it should be easy enough to stand guard while we mosey on out of here, huh?
97331.objectivesText: Escort Zimmix Sputterspark away from the Ruins of Zul'Kunda then tell Wharfmaster Lozgil in Booty Bay of your successful rescue.
97331.title: Zimmix's Great Escape

97891.description:
You! Quickly, I need you to bring this potion across the slime canal to Doctor Martin Felben in the Apothecarium!

It has a very limited shelf life, and no I can't go myself, my knees rattle and pop out if I attempt to run.

Just another lovely side effect of undeath, apparently.

But we're wasting time! Here, take this and go!

<Alessandro makes a shooing motion.>
97891.objectivesText: Bring the Unstable Potion to Doctor Martin Felben in the Apothecarium within the time limit.
97891.title: Prompt Potion Runner

97906.description:
You've become a leatherworker. Good for you, $c. I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to make yourself a tent that will keep you cool on hot days, and dry on rainy days.

With a good tent over your head, you'll ensure that you get all the rest you need to stay sharp on your travels.
97906.objectivesText: Speak with Karolek in Orgrimmar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97906.title: Camping 101: Leatherworking

97915.description:
So, you chose to cook up brews and potions as an Alchemist. I'm sure that'll come in handy in your travels.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Mana Well for your camp. Build one of these and all of the healers and spellcaster types will come running to get a refreshing taste.
97915.objectivesText: Speak with Alchemist Mallory in Elwynn Forest near Stormwind to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97915.title: Camping 101: Alchemy

97926.description:
I wish it was that easy to help, $c. I really do.

Should you choose to spend more time in our lands, you will find that many are without. Stormwind's coffers are not what they once were, and what remains is spread thin.

Give this reply to the elder the next time you see him. It's not what he's hoping for, but it's all I have to offer right now.
97926.objectivesText: Bring Alexston's Reply to Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine in Darkshore.
97926.title: Making Do

97929.description:
Enchanters make everything better and are always welcome at any camp out in the wilds.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Enchanted Lute for your camp. It's so important to find entertainment during your downtime, and this bit of magic can help ensure you are ready to weather all sorts of challenges when you hit the old dusty trail once again.
97929.objectivesText: Speak with Mot Dawnstrider in Thunder Bluff to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97929.title: Camping 101: Enchanting

97933.description:
Looks to me like you've gained some skill in herbalism. Picking flowers isn't just for dilly-dallying, you know. It can be useful... and profitable.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Incense Candle for your camp. High spirits are a key component to keeping healers and spellcasters in the fight, and an Incense Candle can provide a boost that magic users will surely appreciate.
97933.objectivesText: Speak with Komin Winterhoof in Thunder Bluff to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97933.title: Camping 101: Herbalism

97943.description:
You might not think so, but your skill as a fisherman can actually come in handy at camp.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Fish Bowl for your camp. You can use this fixture to help provide a bit of joy to yourself and your fellow adventurers. A happy adventurer is a strong adventurer and I'm sure your combat capabilities will reflect that.
97943.objectivesText: Speak with Astaia in Darnassus to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97943.title: Camping 101: Fishing

97949.description:
Being able to skillfully harvest the skins and hides of fallen beasts is one of the more valuable skills an adventurer can possess.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Camp Chair for your camp. Sometimes it's important to just take a load off, and you can use some of those hides you've gathered to make a comfy chair to sit in. A bit of relaxation can help ensure that you are at your peak condition and can strike where it counts the next time you find yourself in a dust-up.
97949.objectivesText: Speak with Radnaal Maneweaver on the road to Darnassus from Dolanaar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97949.title: Camping 101: Skinning

97952.description:
So, you've become a Blacksmith. That's a great choice if you want to make sure your blades never dull.

I reckon I know someone that can help with that by teaching you how to craft a Sharpening Wheel. Bring one of these out at your camp and all the warriors and rogues in the area will be lining up to hone their weapons.
97952.objectivesText: Speak with Basil Frye in Undercity to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97952.title: Camping 101: Blacksmithing

97954.description:
Engineers like yourself can cook up all sorts of bits, bots, and bombs for fun and profit.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Reagent Bot for your camp. This helpful automaton can help keep you well-supplied so that you and your allies never run out of the materials needed to fuel your spells.
97954.objectivesText: Speak with Graham Van Talen in Undercity to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97954.title: Camping 101: Engineering

97965.description:
So you've taken up First Aid? That's an honorable... and pragmatic pursuit as a $c.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a First Aid Kit for your camp. Injuries are a reality in the world of adventuring and offering some much-needed healing at your camp could even save lives.

objectives.text: Raise your first aid skill to 20

97965.objectivesText: Speak with Naleeia Tattermend in Shen'dar Village to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97965.title: Camping 101: First Aid

97973.description:
Tailoring is a surprisingly potent tradeskill to invest in, and I'm sure it'll serve you well.

I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Faction Banner for your camp, provided you have the skill for it. Inspiration and morale are a key part of success on any battlefield, and an inspirational banner can go a long way to keeping you energized.
97973.objectivesText: Speak with Taleen Shimmerthread in Shen'dar Village to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97973.title: Camping 101: Tailoring

conditionalDescriptions.text:
You are born kaldorei--the children of the stars--and shall become a great priestess of our goddess Elune. Her grace may illuminate our strengths, helping our strikes hit true, or it may help conceal us just as the moon may eclipse the sun.

Our Long Vigil after the defense of Mount Hyjal has ended, and we have joined an Alliance of others--which you will meet in due time. For now, you are nestled in the boughs of Teldrassil.

Demonstrate Mother Moon's gifts, and bask in her blessings.

97979.description:
You are born kaldorei--the children of the stars--and have inherited a birthright unlike any other in this world. Elune's grace may illuminate our strengths, helping our strikes hit true, or it may help conceal us just as the moon may eclipse the sun.

Our Long Vigil after the defense of Mount Hyjal has ended, and we have joined an Alliance of others--which you will meet in due time. For now, you are nestled in the boughs of Teldrassil.

Demonstrate Mother Moon's gifts, and bask in her blessings.
97979.title: The Goddess Provides

97985.description:
Fascinating, aren't they? This is the first time I have ever been privy to the secrets of abomination creation.

I have been studying these notes, and it appears we need a heart. A massive one!

I hear there is a thunder lizard there of impressive size called Stormheart, that patrols along the canyon edge in Thousand Needles. With a name like that it must have the perfect heart. I must have that heart!

Oh, also I suggest you bring friends. Stormheart isn't known for being docile.
97985.objectivesText: Slay Stormheart in Thousand Needles and acquire its heart.
97985.title: Thundering Hearts

98024.description:
After journeying here from the elemental plane, the problems our lands face may seem small. Rest assured, the dangers the horde faces are very real, and you will grow formidable should you survive your service.

If you'd like to get started doing some good in our world, travel southwest to the vast lands known as the Barrens. There is a settlement there known as the Crossroads. The proud citizens there are ever in need of aid.

Go with honor, adventurer!
98024.objectivesText: Report To Thork at The Crossroads in The Barrens.
98024.title: Journey to the Crossroads

98028.description:
All that remains of the powerful elemental is a globe of what seems to be pure water, clouded by some unknown substance. The edges of the sphere seem to be clear until you turn it--as if the cloud actively prevents you from peering within.

Whatever happened to it--and to the ruins it was guarding--is still active in some way.

Only Onu, the Ancient of Lore at the Grove of the Ancients to the far south, would have a chance at knowing more.
98028.objectivesText: Bring the Clouded Water Globe to Onu at the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore.
98028.title: Baron Marinous

98046.description:
<Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm's gaze narrows.>

You're still here?

Take the phial and get out of my sight, $c. It is clear my answers do not lie in the waters, just as they did not before. 

Perhaps one of the priestesses in the Temple of the Moon to the south will dispose of it.

<Fandral looks away, no longer speaking to you.>

I must look elsewhere if this is to work...
98046.objectivesText: Bring the Drained Vessel to Lariia in the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.
98046.title: Crown of the Earth

98059.description:
Hillsbrad's council hasn't answered our new magistrate's letters. The last word I pried out of a passing merchant from the town did little to justify their silence.

We're only asking for a small platoon--yet I'm told multiple siege ballista rest in pristine condition within a walled-off compound.

Walk into their town hall like a citizen returning a census request, and place this neatly upon the bookkeeping table.

Return to me when the deed is done.

objectives.text: Sealed Company Request delivered to Hillsbrad council

98059.objectivesText: Place the Sealed Company Request you were given on the bookkeeping table within Hillsbrad's town hall.
98059.title: Hillsbrad's Hoard

98065.description:
You must bring this to Tyrande at once! I will transfer it to a more ceremonial container for you.

Do not be afraid. The High Priestess of Elune is firm, but kind. She protects all who enter Darnassus, and carries our goddess' light to all.

She will be glad to receive this sacred water. You will find her directly above us.
98065.objectivesText: Bring the Moonwell Remnants to Tyrande Whisperwind in the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.
98065.title: Crown of the Earth

98069.description:
Those wretched harpies! They attacked the last caravan I had scheduled to deliver supplies to Freewind Post. We have enough supplies for the moment, but without more supplies, we'll run short soon.

I'm not sure what the harpies plan to do with the extra supplies, but I would be grateful if you would recover them for me. They make their lair west of here. They can be found both at the base of the cliffside and inside a cave at the top.
98069.objectivesText: Bring 8 Stolen Freewind Supplies to Jandia in Freewind Post.
98069.title: Stolen Freewind Supplies

98070.description:
The Screeching Canyon is home to a local band of harpies known for their ferocious nature and raiding tactics. They have ambushed the last few supply caravans that have been brave enough to traverse this place.

I fear if something isn't done soon, there will be no caravans that will dare make the trek to Freewind Post.

Go, slay as many of these harpies as you are able. Return to me once the deed has been done, and I will reward you well for your efforts.
98070.objectivesText: Slay $1oa Screeching Harpies, $2oa Screeching Roguefeather Harpies and $3oa Screeching Windcaller Harpies.
98070.title: Stop the Screeching

98093.description:
I'm so glad you saw me!

The weather was lovely this morning, so I walked from Camp Taurajo down the golden road. When it came time to head back, I couldn't--a pack of hyenas started circling, and Stormhide lizards blocked my only escape.

Scrambling up this tree I went, and now there are too many foes about at this hour for me to make the run home through the fields.

Would you mind clearing out these Stormhide and Hecklefang Stalkers for me?
98093.objectivesText: Sulhasa in southern Barrens wants you to clear out $1oa Stormhide lizards and $2oa Hecklefang Stalkers in the area so she can leave the tree safely.
98093.title: Field to Clear

98094.description:
Now that we can trust you to deliver critical information to our forward spies, there's an extra task for you.

Bring this to Deathstalker Masoj almost directly south of us. He'll have more for you to do once you get there and hand this to him. He is posted on elevated terrain north of the rotten vineyard they call Nethander Stead.

Our plan to take control of these lands continues steadily.
98094.objectivesText: High Executor Darthalia wants you to deliver updated orders to Deathstalker Masoj, south of Tarren Mill, outside of Dun Garok.
98094.title: Scout Support

98095.description:
Our high command inserts strategic troops using bat riders. Key points around the foothills have lost their signaling beacons.

Take these vials. Uncork them in three locations: the hills bordering Dun Garok, the plateau overlooking Dunholde Keep, and the last on the ridge of the Headland above the town of Hillsbrad. The vapors that emanate will be like a potent tuning rod to the senses of the bat, drawing them to the desired drop-off points once more.

Look for crushed empty vials and renew our marks.
98095.objectivesText: Deathstalker Masoj needs you to place the three Apothecary Vials on peaks around Hillsbrad Foothills and return to him.
98095.title: Valuable Vantages

98190.description:
You'll want to take this to Stormwind right away. Proud as I am that this keep and harbor bears King Terenas Menethil II's name, we are a calm harbor in a very nasty storm of enemies. It's just not safe here.

The Dragonmaw in particular would sacrifice much to loot something like this... and I shudder to think of what they'd do with it.

Don't bother going up the chain of command on this one, $Glad:lass;. Go straight to Highlord Fordragon with this. He'll know where it will be best kept.
98190.objectivesText: Bring the Menethil Statuette to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind Keep.
98190.title: A Friend of the Family

98208.description:
I came to Menethil Harbor from Auberdine, from the great tree Teldrassil, to recover a bloom of great import to my people.

My people's ship the Flying Osprey crashed here many moons ago, joined with the Kul Tiran Third Fleet. Among its cargo was the flower known as Nord'el--Bloom of the Heavens in your tongue--bloomed under a full moon at the peak of Mount Hyjal, our former home.

Please help me retrieve it! The wreckage is just south of the city, but it is inhabited by fierce murloc raiders!
98208.objectivesText: Recover Nord'el for Sylessa Duskwhisper in Menethil Harbor.
98208.title: Bloom of the Heavens

98246.description:
I'll need some eggs if my plan is going tae work. Bassbeak needs a nice an' full belly--I ain't in the business of hoppin' on the back of a surly gryphon.

They need to be perfect--no cracks or anything.

Take some from the Razormaw raptors--they're known for having yolks the size of a gnome's noggin. You can find 'em in Raptor Ridge to the northeast and Saltspray Glen to the northwest.

Let's make it a nice even dozen, just to be safe.
98246.objectivesText: Gather $1oa Perfect Razormaw Eggs for Howin Kindfeather.
98246.title: Trying Times

conditionalDescriptions.text:
Gaaah!

I'm so angry. They said Ashenvale was easy to follow. Easy for who? The beasts? The birds?

One moment I was gathering an herb, the next I'm trapped in this ravine. Do I truly have to circle half the forest to reach where I stood just moments ago?

When I'm like this, my spells grow volatile and behave... differently.

Could you thin the wildlife nearby? Their stupid digging grates on me. I despise this cursed forest.

98251.description:
Gaaah!

I'm so angry. They said Ashenvale was easy to follow. Easy for who? The beasts? The birds?

One moment I was gathering an herb, the next I'm trapped in this ravine. Do I truly have to circle half the forest to reach where I stood just moments ago?

When I'm like this, my spells grow volatile and behave... differently.

Could you thin the wildlife nearby? Even their stupid hooves grate on me. I despise this cursed forest.
98251.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Shadowhorn Stag and $2oa Ashenvale Bear and return to Va'xug Firefure northwest of Fallen Sky Lake.
98251.title: Never Coming Back

98298.description:
Ah, it's all become so embarrassingly clear! Arugal hardly had any magic at all, let alone enough to create the worgen. 'Arugal's Curse.' Pah! Barely potent enough to last a few seconds.

These shackles prove he can bind the beasts, not create them. The worgen clearly spread their curse a different way. I would know how.

Go to the Greymane Wall to the south. The worgen seem to be spreading to the humans nearby. Tear the beasts apart and bring me whatever you find. This requires a more direct approach.
98298.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Worgen Bits to Dalar Dawnweaver in The Sepulcher.
98298.title: Arugal's Folly

98313.description:
Whatever this is all about, $n, it's epic stuff alright.

I'll bundle everything up nice for you. Take it to Historian Karnik in the Hall of Explorers in Ironforge. You'll usually find him in the back, nose-deep in some tome or another in the library.

It'll take a downright army to crack the case on this one, but if what we've seen so far is any indication it will well be worth it!
98313.objectivesText: Bring the Whelgar Relic Package to Historian Karnik in Ironforge.
98313.title: For Further Study

98340.description:
It would seem that you are ready for the next step in your journey, young druid. Dendrite Starblaze has sent for you, and wishes for you to seek him out in Moonglade once again.

You have already learned to call upon the magic to take you to Moonglade, so you should be able to embark immediately if you choose. I would suggest you leave soon, if you wish to continue your druidic training.
98340.objectivesText: Speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.
98340.title: The Great Cat Spirit

98342.description:
To draw upon my spirit, you will need more than a few words. To understand and respect my form you must prove that you can embody cunning, stealth, and if you should be cornered, ferocity.

In the Barrow Dens just east of here, are three relics of my favor you must acquire. They are guarded by powerful enraged spirits that will attack you on sight. A statue at the entrance will bless you with temporary stealth to get past them.

Return these relics to me. We will see if you are ready to take my shape.
98342.objectivesText: Recover the Relic of the Fang, Relic of the Claw, and Relic of the Silent Shadow from the Stormrage Barrow Den, and return them to the Great Cat Spirit.
98342.title: The Great Cat Spirit

conditionalDescriptions.text:
If you remember but one thing, know this: not even death can stop the Light.

This we have in common with all Forsaken--we have overcome what the living view as their end. However, some even among our own fear us; they suspect we will smite them as some monstrosity.

In truth, our relationship with undeath is complex, but we are not here to hurt our own. Help me show the others this. Venture to Night's Web Hollow to the northwest and free the freshly raised fools trapped by the spiders there.

Then they will see our nature.

98389.description:
Greetings, $c. Yes, I am a paladin. Not even death can stop the Light.

This is something my kind have in common with all Forsaken--we have overcome what the living view as their end. However, some even among our own fear us; they suspect we will smite them as some monstrosity.

In truth, our relationship with undeath is complex, but I am not here to hurt our own. Help me show the others this. Venture to Night's Web Hollow to the northwest and free the freshly raised fools trapped by the spiders there.
98389.objectivesText: Free $1oa Webbed Victims in Night's Web Hollow for Aramis Hammerhand in Deathknell.
98389.title: A Light in the Darkness

conditionalDescriptions.text:
Blessings to you, $Gsister:fellow priest;. Our Sisterhood of Elune has stood as a pillar of kaldorei society for thousands of years.

Before the Great Sundering, before the War of the Ancients, through the Long Vigil, we have guided and healed our people through the darkness. Such is our charge, and such is the demand of the peerless Mother Moon.

We now require your aid in a matter of great importance. Sister Aquinne awaits your arrival in Darnassus.

98391.description:
Blessings to you, $c. The Sisterhood of Elune has stood as a pillar of kaldorei society for thousands of years.

Before the Great Sundering, before the War of the Ancients, through the Long Vigil, we have guided and healed our people through the darkness. Such is our charge, and such is the demand of the peerless Mother Moon.

We now require your aid in a matter of great importance. Sister Aquinne awaits your arrival in Darnassus.
98391.objectivesText: Speak to Sister Aquinne in Darnassus.
98391.title: The Sisterhood of Elune

98397.description:
The time has come for us to part ways once again, young one, as the application of your lessons takes you back to the one who sent you to me. It would seem your instructor, Mathrengyl Bearwalker, has found a worthy pupil in you. I believe I see one as well. Heed his lessons and you shall soon be able to draw upon the Great Cat Spirit to take its shape.

Go back to whence you came. When the time is right, we will meet again.
98397.objectivesText: Return to Darnassus and speak with Mathrengyl Bearwalker in the Cenarion Enclave.
98397.title: To Darnassus

98407.description:
If the gnolls are growing so bold they are willing to camp this close to humans, there's no telling how much further they'll go. We need to deter them.

The beasts are hardly organized, but they seem to respect strength above all else. If we can slay the worst of them, maybe claim some of their trophies, we can remind these gnolls why they should stay in the hills where they belong.

Should you see any of their thrashers, bring me their collars. That should put the fear of the Alliance back into them.
98407.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Spiked Collars from Redridge Thrashers for Deputy Feldon near Lakeshire.
98407.title: Show of Force

98418.description:
Kurothel mentioned sightings of what they say are wolf-men. Those of the pack now lurking in greater numbers in our forest. Last we had spoken, druids were pursuing communication with those of the beast heart who displayed measured control of their animal instincts.

His written words show a darker struggle. If there is anything we can do to help see HIM again, surely quelling the demon threat that is driving him to this burning transformation will be of aid to his anguished soul.

Slay the Xavian, $n.
98418.objectivesText:
Kill $1oa Xavian Rogues, $2oa Felsworn, $3oa Betrayers, and $4oa Hellcallers.
Return to Maseara Autumnmoon in Forest Song afterwards.
98418.title: Shared Fury

98435.description:
Our elders in Thunder Bluff must know of the progress we have made here, thanks to your aid.

Please, take this to Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff. You will find him in the Elder Rise, on the east side of the city. You must take the lifts up to the center of the city, then cross the bridges to reach it.
98435.objectivesText: Bring Thunderhorn's Report to Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.
98435.title: Thunderhorn's Report

98823.description:
Truly, this is a fascinating object.

It shows indications of being much more than a mere carving or sculpture.

While our elders may be interested in observing this artifact, the Earthen Ring are who would carry the most wisdom for our buried ruins and forgotten lands. Seek out Muln Earthfury, a direct approach is fitting for the gravity of what you carry.

You can find him and other elders of the Earthen Ring council at the Skywatcher Plateau in northwest Mulgore.
98823.objectivesText: Bring the Titan Relic to Muln Earthfury at the Skywatcher Plateau in northwest Mulgore.
98823.title: Earthen Echo

98887.description: The Theramore Expeditionary Force are tenacious and continue to send reinforcements to bolster their position on the Darkspear Islands. $B$BGo, show them the might of the Horde! Bring me the evidence of your victory in this key battleground and you will be well rewarded.
98887.objectivesText: Bring 3 Darkspear Islands Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
98887.title: Conflict at Darkspear Islands

98895.description: The battle against the Darkspear Raiders is heating up. Without urgent aid, the Darkspear Islands will be lost to us. $B$BIt is your duty as a proud member of the Alliance to ensure this does not happen. Bring me proof of your contributions on the front lines and you will be revered as a hero of the Alliance!
98895.objectivesText: Bring 3 Darkspear Islands Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.
98895.title: Darkspear Islands Clash

98897.description: The battle against the Darkspear Raiders is heating up. Without urgent aid, the Darkspear Islands will be lost to us. $B$BIt is your duty as a proud member of the Alliance to ensure this does not happen. Bring me proof of your contributions on the front lines and you will be revered as a hero of the Alliance!
98897.objectivesText: Bring 3 Darkspear Islands Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.
98897.title: Darkspear Islands Clash

98908.description:
The battle at the Darkspear Islands be locked in a stalemate, $c. Show those Alliance fools who the superior force is. 

Carry your head high in service of the Darkspear and claim victory in battle. The Loa will surely be givin' you their blessing, $c!
98908.objectivesText: Win a Darkspear Islands battleground and return back to Nizook Boof at The Merchant Coast.
98908.title: The Battle for Darkspear Islands!

99073.description:
The salve is ready. Take it to Eralya swiftly.

I do not know if it will truly cure her. The rot festers quickly, and grows in strength as it spreads.

It will, if nothing else, ease her suffering. And that is still worth your haste.
99073.objectivesText: Take the Lashwater Salve to Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow on the road to the Oracle Tree.
99073.title: Easing Suffering

conditionalDescriptions.text:
Hail, young warrior. Our journey together shall take many strides, but this step is no less important than the others.

Before you lies the arena. In it, it matters not who you call mother or whether you wield sword or mace. All are equal, and all learn to sharpen their horns in direct combat.

Enter our space, and learn through combat. You may face any of these novices, or any other willing adversary. I care not which.

99108.description:
Hail, young $c. Though you are not a warrior and I cannot teach you that path, that does not mean you would not benefit from my tutelage.

Before you lies the arena. In it, it matters not who you call mother or whether you wield sword or bow. All are equal, and all learn to sharpen their horns in direct combat.

Will you enter our space, and learn our ways for yourself? You may face any of these novices, or any other willing adversary. I care not which.

objectives.text: Player Duels won or Novice Warriors defeated

99108.objectivesText: Defeat 3 other players in duels or Novice Warriors for Tang Stonehoof.
99108.title: Sparring Match
